title: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum development and literacy instruction
summary: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum work and supervised prompt practice; its public sources do not establish improvements in learning or educator efficiency.
account: StratLoom's public site describes AI-enhanced curriculum development, AI-integrated instructional workflows, and supervised prompt practice within its Digital Roots programs. These sources support an intended-benefit record about AI-assisted instructional work. They do not provide a named pilot school, participant-level data, a comparison group, or evidence that AI caused the broader training outcomes claimed by the organization.
